qs.q: How does controlled fertility directly impact maternal and child health?
o: It accelerates the biological aging of reproductive organs
It increases the risk of pregnancy-related complications
It eliminates the need for postnatal care systems
It reduces maternal health risks and child mortality declines
qs.e: Maternal health improves with controlled fertility, which reduces the risks of pregnancy-related complications. Child mortality also declines when families have fewer children and can access better healthcare.
